restaurantName: TOZI Grand Cafe @ Battersea Power Station
bio: Inspired by the elegance of Europe’s famous grand cafes, TOZI Grand Cafe celebrates Italy’s greatest treasures at 3a Electric Boulevard. Situated right next to London Battersea Power Station guests are invited to enjoy a delicious selection of sweet and savoury Italian afternoon treats either inside the grand cafe, or in the art’otel Battersea Power Station hotel lobby.  Adorned with artwork created by award-winning Spanish artist and designer Jaime Hayon and enjoy prosciutto, mozzarella and rocket on perfectly toasted ciabatta, with Maritozzi & Cured meats, pickles and cheese followed by those with a sweet tooth, pistachio cannoli’s and valhorona chocolate tarts.  Guests can enjoy the Afternoon Tea alongside a wide selection of Good & Proper teas or if preferred, a sparkling bottle of chilled Franciacorta.
pageTitle: TOZI Grand Cafe @ Battersea Power Station
